widgets.text: Six arcade classics: Asteroids, Battlezone, Centipede, Missile Command, Super Breakout and Tempest.

rows: A thrust, B fire, L hyperspace
A/B/R fire from the three bases
D-pad spin, A fire, B zapper

widgets.text: Asteroids: shoot big rocks one at a time and stay mid-screen; hunt UFOs for points. Missile Command: lead incoming missiles and protect the middle base. Tempest: use the superzapper when spikers crowd the rim. Centipede: clear mushrooms near the bottom.
Pick a game from the main menu; each game has its own options and high-score table.
Each game has an info screen with its history and the original arcade cabinet art.
Arcade games loop forever: aim for the high score in each of the six games.
